headline: Every multipack of ice cream checked, not a sample.
formProduct: Ice cream sticks and cones in multipack cartons
label: #F4E6C8
visitLine: Call and visit to your plant
heroLede: With close to three million servings a day, a wrong carton or a bad code is easy to miss by eye. Here's what a camera check could look like on your multipack lines. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every multipack carton is closed and glued, flaps down and square. An open carton in a freezer means damaged sticks and a complaint from the store.
labelLede: A classic pack and an almond pack look much the same at line speed, and one of them carries tree nuts. The camera checks every carton carries the right label for the sticks inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every carton. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Stick offcuts, wrapper film and glove pieces can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a case.

vocab.alert: Four open flaps in fifteen minutes. Check the cartoner.
